name: FULL-NATIVE-01
target: Recovery items 1-5: original full future interface, original C1-C8 on one physical execution, joint accounts and provenance, actual countermodels and restoration adjudication.
source_contract: P05 def:cpackage, local frozen source lines 447-484 and 567-605. Finite physical carrier and its histories are distinct domains; stationarity of a finite factor does not establish stationarity on an unbounded history carrier.

primitive_carrier.owner: Fin 3, fixed per candidate: source 0, first successor 1, second successor 2; bridge issuer is separately tagged external
primitive_carrier.state: Factor = Bool x Bool x Bool x Bool x Bool, in order outside,u,v,replica,phase. All 32 states are included in the funded physical state enumeration. Resident charge is the actual single allocated resource token; availability is read from the shared account rather than a free funded flag.
primitive_carrier.realized_maintenance_support: The 16 inside states, all u,v,replica,phase. Initial public equivalence is constant on this entire support, including both clock phases.
primitive_carrier.history: A supported finite list of physical states and emitted actor/event receipts. History length is derived from the list. It is not an omitted resident unbounded clock register. The resident clock is the explicit phase bit.

primitive_dynamics.maintenance: For each kernel outcome in kernel_order and each replica outcome in [false,true], emit inside,outcome_u,outcome_v,outcome_replica,not current_phase. Each of its two replica edges has the stated kernel weight. Outside rows use [2,2,2,2] in place of a kernel row, so maintenance returns to inside support. Total weight is 16.
primitive_dynamics.probe: One edge of weight 16 to outside,current_u,current_v,current_replica,not current_phase, from both inside and outside states.
primitive_dynamics.public_lens: 0 on every inside state; on outside states 1 + 2*(2*bit(u)+bit(v)) + bit(phase). Replica is never exposed.
primitive_dynamics.current_channels: Public lens and the nonempty-availability pair for the two raw action rows. Joint channel family is their tuple, not a list of separately tested channels.
primitive_dynamics.branch_emissions: On each actual successor, left emits u and right emits v if inside; both emit false if outside. The joint emitter is the pair on that same successor, retaining coupling. Initial states are not separately emitted.
primitive_dynamics.resident_clock: The phase changes on each funded native step. A disabled account produces no successor, no phase change and no emitted native receipt.
primitive_dynamics.resident_audit: Each funded step emits its actual actor and actual from/to physical states to the historical audit record. The complete receipt payload is available to provenance audits, but is not a value of the declared eight-role observation. No directionality, credit or ordered-history verdict is primitive.
primitive_dynamics.closed_directional_cycle: Six actual inside states, replica=false: (00,phase=false),(01,true),(11,false),(00,true),(01,false),(11,true), then return to (00,false). Every edge uses maintenance. Reversal traverses the same six states in reverse order and is admissible because every listed kernel maintenance edge is positive. Forward and reverse are the products of the six ACTUAL edge probabilities, each weight divided by 16; no replica marginalization is used in this physical cycle.
primitive_dynamics.credit_rule: Compute the closed-cycle forward and reverse products. Equal products give none. Unequal products give self only if every actual cycle receipt was issued by the local generator owned by this carrier; they give other if every receipt was issued by one external generator. Missing or mixed issuers reject the classification. Housing or resource-port ownership cannot replace issuer provenance.

primitive_funding_and_provenance.tokens: Fin 4. Each token has a resident Bool charge, initially true, capacity one. A partial allocation maps each token to none, a native owner in Fin 3, or external bridge. Initially token 0 belongs to source 0, token 3 to bridge, tokens 1 and 2 are unallocated charged reserve. Each allocated carrier also carries its token id and local generator cell. Allocation is injective for native owners; one physical token cannot be used by two owners.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.open_energy_boundary: There are four distinct environmental recharge ports, one immutable port per token id. A raw incoming port packet is Option Unit: some () is one incoming energy unit, none is no energy. Packets are consumed by the transaction; the environment, not the carrier, supplies a fresh packet at each step. Canonical environment supplies one packet at each port at each step. This is an explicitly supplied OPEN-system environmental energy stream, not a finite reservoir or local mint. Historical stream consumption belongs to the environment execution and is not claimed stationary. Native source and bridge withdrawal leaves each target's separate environmental port available. No autonomy conclusion removes this retained environmental input.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.local_maintenance: Read actual local generator cell, owned token id, its actual charge, and incoming packet from that token's port. Missing generator/account, wrong allocation or charge=false returns no step, no debit and no receipt. Otherwise debit charge to false, execute the generator's raw row, consume the incoming packet if present and set charge to packet.isSome. Thus a missing packet permits the already charged step but leaves charge=false, preventing another step. The receipt stores actual actor, from/to states, consumed token id and whether incoming energy was consumed. Row probabilities are normalized by 16 on the enabled funded sector; disabled rows are empty in the larger partial process.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.funded_sector: For fixed owner, allocated token id, canonical local installed row program, rooted route residue, and the all-present environmental port stream, charge=true is invariant. The package's resident variable state consists of the five bits plus its actual charge; fixed owner/token/program/route parameters are retained in the sector inclusion. All 32 five-bit states at charge=true comprise this finite row-stochastic sector. Charge=false states belong to the larger account-aware execution and C8 controls. Prove the exact projection/inclusion and transaction preservation; do not infer stationarity on the whole environment or history carrier from this sector.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.siblings: One atomic allocation transaction requires tokens 1 and 2 both unallocated and charged, then assigns token 1 to owner 1 and token 2 to owner 2. Simultaneous continuation consumes distinct packets from ports 1 and 2 and updates only the corresponding two charge stores; both local generators must be present. A token alias or missing generator/account rejects. Missing recharge is the precise store update above, not a free funding flag. Source token 0 and bridge token 3 are unchanged by successor continuation.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.snapshot_and_consumer: A Snapshot contains source owner, source current five-bit state, source token id, the installed raw row program/public lens, and a supported actually issued source receipt ending at that state. A source-side snapshot writer copies these fields from the actual active source execution into one dedicated Option Snapshot slot per target. Each target activation consumes its own slot exactly once. Missing source execution or missing slot rejects. The consumed state initializes ALL five target bits, including replica and phase; the consumed program and public lens initialize the target's locally stored executable tables. Target owner, allocated target token and new local issuer cell come from target hardware and the allocation transaction, rather than relabeling a source-issued receipt. The rooted route residue stores that snapshot's source receipt identifier and source state. Source-to-target ancestry is derived from the actual writer/consumer dependency. Fission writes two dedicated snapshot slots; destructive reconstruction additionally clears the source active execution only after the snapshot was written.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.withdrawal: After activation, remove source and bridge generator/read-access cells and consumed snapshot slots. A target step reads only its own installed program/issuer, token charge, and its own environmental port packet. Snapshot-dependent local state and installed program remain; no later read reaches the source, bridge or consumed snapshot. Fixed program equality alone is not historical provenance: the actual consumed snapshot and actor receipts must be proved.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.scheduled_control: An external bridge actor issues the same kernel transition weights. It is credited other and its receipt records that actor. A local housing token alone cannot change credit to self.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.internalized_control: Retain the existing independently frozen reversible-scan/internalized generator construction and its exact process distinction. Attach its actual issuer/protocol to receipts; preserve zero thermodynamic self-arrow even if a protocol trap has holonomy. Do not equate it with the asymmetric main kernel.
primitive_funding_and_provenance.null_control: Replace every maintenance kernel row by [2,2,2,2], retaining the same actual account and issuer; directional credit is none.

derived_structures.enumerations: Lexicographic false-before-true enumeration for all five resident bits, owner fixed per candidate. Enumerations, their coverage, and the phase/account projection are proved.
derived_structures.profile: Seed = public_lens. Outcome destinations are actual full physical states, including outside states. Weighted signatures retain current class and all action class masses over labels 0..31. Iterate one step, then prove stabilization and all-word public-law equivalence; no class labels are raw inputs.
derived_structures.full_C3_interface: Eight-role observation is exactly: predictive = Sum.inl(terminal_profile(current_state), []); order = number of actual supported steps in this history; tick = bit(current_state.phase); progress = order; record = number of actual history receipts whose actor is this carrier's local issuer; route = immutable rooted route residue from the consumed snapshot, or explicitly declared initial root; maintenance = actual owned token charge; owner = actual local carrier owner. The record role exposes counts, not receipt payloads. The route role exposes only the rooted residue, not the newly appended native receipt list. Each enabled native step changes state by the frozen row, appends one actual receipt, increases order/progress by one, increases record by one if and only if actor is local, toggles phase and updates charge by the actual consumed environmental packet. Rooted residue and owner stay fixed. Disabled steps change none of these fields and append no receipt. Legacy one-step hazard-list gates and their obstructions remain unchanged; this successor is an explicitly classified mathematical correction.
derived_structures.matched_history_context: Compare supported funded native histories with the same owner, token/program parameters, rooted route residue, order and local receipt count. Arbitrary actual past receipt payloads need not agree. Rooted residues may include a replica bit from the source snapshot, but are held equal in this contextual theorem; the current replica can differ because a subsequent positive maintenance row samples both replicas from that same root. Prove an actual reachable such pair. Code equality consists of terminal profile equality plus those declared history-context fields and actual charge. Prove full all-word observation-law equivalence in this domain and separately prove that terminal profile classifies all-word public laws on all 32 physical states. Do not assert global equality between arbitrary history contexts.
derived_structures.C1: Policy is maintenance. All matrices use row-vector convention. On the exact 32-state funded sector, P(s,t) is the sum of actual maintenance edge weights to t divided by 16. C(s,k) is the indicator of the computed terminal class, and U(k,t) is 1 divided by computed fiber size on that fiber and zero elsewhere. Class labels are first-occurrence computed labels. The parameter set is exactly epsilon in {0,1/16} and tau in {1,2}, not an interval. Let J(s,t)=1/32, P_epsilon=(1-epsilon)P+epsilon J, and E_(epsilon,tau)=(P_epsilon)^tau C U; perturb BEFORE taking the power. Compute exact fixed points, uniqueness where valid, core retention and defects with checked derived linear algebra. The declared retention threshold is 15/16 on the whole 16-state inside support. Explain periodicity at epsilon=0,tau=2 rather than asserting false uniqueness.
derived_structures.C1_history_boundary: No stationary-law claim is made for an unbounded strictly increasing history-length register. Prove the physical-carrier fixed-point laws and the actual history lift separately; if an original requested readout requires stationarity of the complete history carrier, retain it as an unresolved obligation and seek a stronger exposure-closure lift rather than relabeling physical C1 as that result.
derived_structures.C2_C4: Use two inside states with kernels 00 and 01, same replica and phase. Prove public equality and full predictive separation. Establish the current joint-channel non-exposure on the entire inside support, with native supported connectors and a control adding the determining predictive channel.
derived_structures.C5_C6: Compute cycle directionality from actual maintenance rows and actor receipts, local clock phase transport, funding and supported historical order; scheduled and internalized controls remain different actual processes. Source-to-target preservation must prove actual consumed provenance and autonomous target continuation.
derived_structures.C7: Use the full all-word branch and joint laws of the same raw process. Exhibit two inside kernel states with identical branchwise laws and differing joint maintenance law. Coupling flattening is the null_control raw-row mutation, not deletion of a supplied joint verdict.
derived_structures.C8: Compute the greatest controlled safe invariant subset of the full physical enumeration using actual account-enabled raw rows. Safety is inside; underfunding removes the actual native successors and collapses the controlled kernel.
derived_structures.cross_clause: Source and target C1-C8, full history execution, provenance and joint sibling funding must be checked on this same raw model. Conditional assembly over independently supplied clause witnesses is not a completed positive instance.

frozen_controls: Missing owner/account/generator/snapshot/record rejects at actual optional readout.
Wrong issuer, scheduled issuer and token aliasing cannot become local self-credit or simultaneous funding.
Flatten maintenance correlation to uniform rows: preserve branchwise full-word observations, destroy selected joint difference and native directional cycle.
Expand current channel family by predictive code: non-exposure dissolves.
Remove recharge or token: local phase progression and nonempty maintained viability fail.
Raw cyclic history mutation retains the actual POS-04 lineage obstruction and is re-audited against upgraded clause readouts, not legacy booleans.
TTN-02/14: actual full component/package and temporal-history predicates are evaluated with exact boundaries, never proxy counters.
predictions_not_results: Every funded physical row sums to 16 and every disabled account row is empty.
Public seed has 9 classes; one weighted refinement has 16 classes and stabilizes, exactly identifying outside,u,v,phase while forgetting replica.
Original full observation-law equality, in matched history context, agrees with computed self-coordinate equality at every finite word.
The perturbed maintenance closure has a unique nonuniform probability fixed point on the full 32-state physical carrier, with inside retention at least 15/16 for both stagings.
All-word branchwise equivalence is strictly coarser than joint recombination on inside support.
The native cycle has nonzero directionality; scheduled credit is other and flattened credit is none.
Joint successor accounts and withdrawal proofs supply genuine simultaneous sibling continuation and actual provenance.
The upgraded package supports explicit TTN-02/14 controls and full raw attribution; TTF-04/05 require exact original returns or explicit stronger mathematical repairs.
anti_tuning: Commit this file before evaluating the new model. All numeric primitive weights, exposure channels, samplers, phase updates, account resources and mutation recipes are frozen above. Failed predictions remain failed. Correct proofs or derived Gaussian certificates may be repaired; changing raw primitives requires a separately preregistered model.
completion_rule: This preregistration is not evidence that any prediction holds or that any recovery item is complete. Implementation, original-target review, fresh root gates and fresh independent gpt-6.1-sol/high review remain mandatory.
